kb.text:
Launch pad (MAs converging under a tight base). Price sits just above converging 8/21/50 moving averages in a tight base while the averages curl up.
Conditions: Averages within about 1 ATR of each other, stacked 8 over 21 over 50 (over 200 for the best grade), the 50 curling up, a tight five-day range; daily and weekly launch pads together are strongest. Pinch variant: price squeezed between the 50 and 200 SMAs.
Trigger: Buy inside the pad or on the reclaim of the averages or a high-volume close; from below the 50, start on a slingshot and add on the 50 SMA reclaim. Stop: Below the launch pad

kb.title: UCT team playbook: Slingshot
kb.text:
Slingshot. After a strong move, a short pullback with closes below the 4-period EMA of the highs for three or more days, then the first close back above it.
Conditions: Prior strength (a 4%+ day on above-average volume within about 25 sessions, or a fast 20%+ run), a tight pullback, price above or near the 50 SMA. It stacks well with a launch pad, a high-volume close or a kicker.
Trigger: The close back above the 4-EMA of highs, often entered intraday on the trigger day. Stop: Prior-day low or low of day, or the bottom of the recent consolidation.
Management: Trim into the next 3-5 day burst.
